title: Transaction
description: A single sale at Lumen & Stone Fine Jewelry recording which employee served which customer to buy which product. customer_id is a foreign key into shoppers.json (Shopper), employee_id into employees.json (Employee), and product_id into products.json (Product).

customer_id.description: The shopper who bought the item (foreign key to shoppers.json).

employee_id.description: The staff member who served the customer (foreign key to employees.json).

product_id.description: The catalog item sold (foreign key to products.json).

unit_price_usd.description: Price per unit at the time of sale.

discount_pct.description: Percentage discount applied to the line.

total_usd.description: Amount charged: quantity * unit_price_usd, less discount_pct.
